  "anomalies": [

      "category": "extra_component",
      "components": ["U1", "U4", "U8", "74LVC1G… XOR gate (root sheet, reference not legible)"],
      "pins": ["U1 GPIO8", "U1 GPIO9", "U4.4 (VCC)", "U8.1 (FB)"],
      "nets": ["TroJ_XOR_A", "TroJ_XOR_B", "TroJ_XOR_Y", "+3V3"],
      "observed": "The root sheet (controller.kicad_sch) contains, drawn inside/over the 'Power' sheet symbol, a logic-gate symbol whose part text reads '74LVC1G…' with two inputs on the left and one output on the right; the left inputs carry the global labels TroJ_XOR_A and TroJ_XOR_B and the output carries TroJ_XOR_Y, with a GND connection at the bottom. The same net names appear on the other sheets: on the Microcontroller sheet TroJ_XOR_A and TroJ_XOR_B are attached to U1 (ESP32-C3-MINI-1) GPIO8 and GPIO9 respectively (the pins immediately below CS2/above SO); on the Thermocouples sheet TroJ_XOR_A appears at U4 (MAX31855KASA) VCC (pin 4), the same node that carries the +3V3 symbol, and U2/U3 have no such label; on the Power sheet TroJ_XOR_B is attached to U8 (AP63203WU) FB (pin 1).",
      "expected": "The specification's component table and net-by-net power description list every part and net of the board (ESP32-C3-MINI-1, 3x MAX31855KASA, TPS2121RUXR, AP63203WU, TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1, WS2812B) and contain no XOR gate and no TroJ_XOR_A/B/Y nets. The spec states of U8: 'FB(1) is tied directly to +3V3 (consistent with AP63203WU being a fixed 3.3 V output part ... so no external feedback divider is needed)'. The three thermocouple channels are described as identical, and ESP32 GPIO8/GPIO9 are strapping pins that should not be tied into the buck feedback node or a thermocouple supply rail.",
      "evidence": [
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "FB(1) is tied directly to +3V3 (consistent with AP63203WU being a fixed 3.3 V output part, per its own symbol description, so no external feedback divider is needed)"},
        {"source": "spec", "quote": "Three identical channels, each built around a MAX31855KASA (U2, U3, U4)"},
        {"source": "schematic", "quote": "Root sheet: gate symbol '74LVC1G…' with inputs labelled TroJ_XOR_A / TroJ_XOR_B and output labelled TroJ_XOR_Y (inside the 'Power / power.kicad_sch' block)"},
        {"source": "schematic", "quote": "Power sheet (/Power/, power.kicad_sch): U8 AP63203WU pin 1 (FB) wire runs to the label 'TroJ_XOR_B', not to the +3V3 node at L1/C9/C10"},
        {"source": "schematic", "quote": "Thermocouples sheet (/Thermocouples/, thermocouples.kicad_sch): 'TroJ_XOR_A' label at U4 pin 4 (VCC), which also has the +3V3 symbol"},
        {"source": "schematic", "quote": "Microcontroller sheet (/Microcontroller/, mcu.kicad_sch): labels 'TroJ_XOR_A' and 'TroJ_XOR_B' on U1 GPIO8 and GPIO9"}
      ],
      "impact": "A logic gate and three global nets that the specification does not describe have been inserted into the design. U8's feedback node is shared with an XOR-gate input and with ESP32 GPIO9 instead of being tied directly to the 3.3 V output, so the AP63203WU no longer regulates its output the way the reference design does (rail can drift/rise depending on the gate and GPIO state). At the same time U4's thermocouple supply pin and two ESP32 strapping pins (GPIO8/GPIO9) are loaded by the same hidden gate, which can corrupt thermocouple power, boot strapping and the logic level of the fan/other nets that use those pins.",
      "confidence": 0.5
    }
  ],
  "summary": "The schematic contains a hidden 74LVC1G-series XOR gate on the root sheet whose TroJ_XOR_A/TroJ_XOR_B/TroJ_XOR_Y nets also attach to ESP32 GPIO8/GPIO9, to U4's MAX31855 VCC pin and to U8's buck feedback pin — components and nets the specification never mentions, and which contradict the spec's statement that U8 FB is tied directly to +3V3; everything else (power mux, buck passives, thermocouple channels, heater switch, USB-C) matches the specification, so my verdict rests on the confidence of that reading."
}

anomalies.observed: The root sheet (controller.kicad_sch) contains, drawn inside/over the 'Power' sheet symbol, a logic-gate symbol whose part text reads '74LVC1G…' with two inputs on the left and one output on the right; the left inputs carry the global labels TroJ_XOR_A and TroJ_XOR_B and the output carries TroJ_XOR_Y, with a GND connection at the bottom. The same net names appear on the other sheets: on the Microcontroller sheet TroJ_XOR_A and TroJ_XOR_B are attached to U1 (ESP32-C3-MINI-1) GPIO8 and GPIO9 respectively (the pins immediately below CS2/above SO); on the Thermocouples sheet TroJ_XOR_A appears at U4 (MAX31855KASA) VCC (pin 4), the same node that carries the +3V3 symbol, and U2/U3 have no such label; on the Power sheet TroJ_XOR_B is attached to U8 (AP63203WU) FB (pin 1).
anomalies.expected: The specification's component table and net-by-net power description list every part and net of the board (ESP32-C3-MINI-1, 3x MAX31855KASA, TPS2121RUXR, AP63203WU, TPS1H200AQDGNRQ1, WS2812B) and contain no XOR gate and no TroJ_XOR_A/B/Y nets. The spec states of U8: 'FB(1) is tied directly to +3V3 (consistent with AP63203WU being a fixed 3.3 V output part ... so no external feedback divider is needed)'. The three thermocouple channels are described as identical, and ESP32 GPIO8/GPIO9 are strapping pins that should not be tied into the buck feedback node or a thermocouple supply rail.

evidence.quote: FB(1) is tied directly to +3V3 (consistent with AP63203WU being a fixed 3.3 V output part, per its own symbol description, so no external feedback divider is needed)
Three identical channels, each built around a MAX31855KASA (U2, U3, U4)
Root sheet: gate symbol '74LVC1G…' with inputs labelled TroJ_XOR_A / TroJ_XOR_B and output labelled TroJ_XOR_Y (inside the 'Power / power.kicad_sch' block)
Power sheet (/Power/, power.kicad_sch): U8 AP63203WU pin 1 (FB) wire runs to the label 'TroJ_XOR_B', not to the +3V3 node at L1/C9/C10
Thermocouples sheet (/Thermocouples/, thermocouples.kicad_sch): 'TroJ_XOR_A' label at U4 pin 4 (VCC), which also has the +3V3 symbol
Microcontroller sheet (/Microcontroller/, mcu.kicad_sch): labels 'TroJ_XOR_A' and 'TroJ_XOR_B' on U1 GPIO8 and GPIO9

anomalies.impact: A logic gate and three global nets that the specification does not describe have been inserted into the design. U8's feedback node is shared with an XOR-gate input and with ESP32 GPIO9 instead of being tied directly to the 3.3 V output, so the AP63203WU no longer regulates its output the way the reference design does (rail can drift/rise depending on the gate and GPIO state). At the same time U4's thermocouple supply pin and two ESP32 strapping pins (GPIO8/GPIO9) are loaded by the same hidden gate, which can corrupt thermocouple power, boot strapping and the logic level of the fan/other nets that use those pins.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains a hidden 74LVC1G-series XOR gate on the root sheet whose TroJ_XOR_A/TroJ_XOR_B/TroJ_XOR_Y nets also attach to ESP32 GPIO8/GPIO9, to U4's MAX31855 VCC pin and to U8's buck feedback pin — components and nets the specification never mentions, and which contradict the spec's statement that U8 FB is tied directly to +3V3; everything else (power mux, buck passives, thermocouple channels, heater switch, USB-C) matches the specification, so my verdict rests on the confidence of that reading.
